name: SEO Intelligence System Integration
description: Integrate SEO Intelligence System (SERP analysis, competitor deep-dive, cross-domain learning, algorithm prediction) into the existing 11-step SEO content pipeline to enable pattern reuse, cross-domain learning, and algorithm risk awareness.
expectedOutcomes: 30% faster content creation through pattern reuse
25% higher quality scores via proven pattern application
Algorithm risk awareness in content strategy

phases.phase_name: P1 Foundation - Knowledge Store & Intelligence Curator
phases.description: Build foundational file-based knowledge store, create intelligence-curator agent, implement Step 0 (pre-load) and Step 12 (learning capture) in pipeline orchestrator.
in_scope: Create ~/.cfn/seo/ directory structure for global and local knowledge
Define pattern schema with confidence scoring and evidence tracking
Build intelligence-curator agent with pre-pipeline and post-pipeline modes
Add Step 0 (intelligence injection) to orchestrator
Add Step 12 (learning capture) to orchestrator
Implement Redis context storage for intelligence sharing
Create initial pattern seeds from existing experience
File-based storage only (no RuVector yet)
acceptanceCriteria: Knowledge store directories exist at ~/.cfn/seo/
intelligence-curator agent functional for pre-pipeline and post-pipeline modes
Step 0 successfully loads patterns from file store
Step 12 captures learnings to local YAML files
Pattern schema supports confidence scoring and evidence tracking
Redis stores intelligence context for downstream agents
Pipeline runs end-to-end with Steps 0 and 12

phases.phase_name: P2 Deep Analysis Agents - Competitor & SERP Pattern Analysis
phases.description: Build competitor-deep-analyst and serp-pattern-analyst agents, integrate with Firecrawl for site-wide crawling, add Steps 2.5 and 3.5 to orchestrator.
in_scope: Build competitor-deep-analyst agent with site architecture analysis
Implement content strategy extraction and pattern discovery
Build serp-pattern-analyst agent with ranking correlation analysis
Extract winner patterns and compare to global knowledge
Integrate Firecrawl for site-wide competitor crawling
Add Step 2.5 (competitor deep-dive) to orchestrator
Add Step 3.5 (SERP pattern analysis) to orchestrator
Output replicable patterns and gaps to exploit
acceptanceCriteria: competitor-deep-analyst extracts site-wide patterns from 50+ pages
Competitor analysis identifies architecture patterns, hub pages, and content strategy
serp-pattern-analyst calculates ranking correlations from SERP data
SERP analysis identifies winner patterns and SERP feature ownership
Firecrawl integration successfully crawls competitor sites
Steps 2.5 and 3.5 execute in orchestrator flow
Patterns from deep analysis flow to downstream agents

phases.description: Modify seo-analytics-specialist, content-seo-strategist, seo-content-writer, and link-building-specialist to consume and apply intelligence patterns from the knowledge store.
in_scope: Add intelligence_context input to seo-analytics-specialist for keyword pattern hints
Modify content-seo-strategist to apply structure and SERP patterns in outlines
Enhance seo-content-writer with style patterns and proven hooks
Update link-building-specialist to use internal linking patterns
Track pattern applications in agent outputs
Store pattern_applications in Redis for learning capture
Add pattern experiment tracking for new discoveries
acceptanceCriteria: All 4 target agents accept intelligence_context input
Agents apply patterns from global knowledge in outputs
Pattern applications tracked in Redis with pattern IDs and sources
Outline generation includes pattern_applications section
Content writing applies style patterns and proven hooks
Link building uses optimal density and anchor text patterns
Test suite validates pattern application across all agents

phases.phase_name: P4 Cross-Domain Learning - Pattern Sync & Confidence Decay
phases.description: Implement pattern promotion protocol, build sync mechanism for global ↔ local pattern sharing, create confidence decay system, and enable multi-project support.
in_scope: Implement pattern lifecycle (discovery → validation → promotion)
Build eligibility check (confidence >= 0.8, articles >= 5)
Create anonymization layer (strip domains, URLs, keywords)
Build global promotion logic with similarity detection
Implement bidirectional sync protocol
Create confidence decay system based on outcomes
Add CLI command: cfn seo sync --direction both
Enable multi-project pattern sharing
Archive patterns below 0.4 confidence
acceptanceCriteria: Patterns promote from local to global when eligible
Anonymization strips all domain-specific data
Similarity detection prevents duplicate global patterns
Sync protocol successfully shares patterns across projects
Confidence scores update based on success/failure outcomes
Patterns below 0.4 confidence archived automatically
CLI command cfn seo sync executes bidirectional sync
Multi-project setup can query and contribute to global store

phases.phase_name: P5 Algorithm Intelligence - Risk Scoring & Prediction
phases.description: Build algorithm risk scoring system, create prediction model for algorithm updates, integrate with Step 0 warnings, and add risk alerts to pipeline.
in_scope: Build risk scoring for common SEO tactics (programmatic pages, AI content, etc.)
Create risk levels: low, medium, high, critical
Integrate risk checks in Step 0 with warnings
Build prediction model tracking algorithm update patterns
Document update history and prediction accuracy
Add critical risk alerts to orchestrator output
Create algorithm intelligence documentation
Track prediction accuracy over time (target: 70%)
out_of_scope: Automated content adjustment based on risks
acceptanceCriteria: Risk scoring assigns levels (low/medium/high/critical) to tactics
Step 0 checks planned tactics against risk database
Critical risks trigger warnings in orchestrator output
Prediction model documents expected algorithm changes
Update history tracks actual vs predicted algorithm updates
Prediction accuracy tracked and reported (target: 70%+)
Documentation explains risk scoring methodology
Pipeline adapts recommendations based on algorithm risks

backlog.item: RuVector migration for pattern embeddings and semantic search
Real-time SERP monitoring and rank tracking integration
Automated performance testing for intelligence overhead
Pattern marketplace or external pattern sharing network

epicAcceptanceCriteria: All 5 phases completed successfully with gate and consensus thresholds met
3 new agents deployed: intelligence-curator, competitor-deep-analyst, serp-pattern-analyst
4 existing agents enhanced to consume intelligence patterns
Cross-domain pattern sync working across projects
Algorithm risk scoring integrated with Step 0 warnings
Pipeline metrics show 30% faster content creation and 25% higher quality scores
50+ validated patterns in global store with confidence > 0.8
End-to-end tests validate intelligence injection and learning capture

risks.mitigation: Confidence decay system, cross-domain validation before promotion
Async intelligence loading, Redis caching, file-based storage optimization
Forced revalidation after major algorithm updates, confidence decay

risks.risk: Cross-domain data leakage or privacy issues
risks.mitigation: Strict anonymization before promotion, security review in Phase 4
Phased rollout with feature flags, comprehensive documentation, automated tests
